title: Billiger.de Product Offers Scraper
description: Compare Billiger.de product offers by shop, price, shipping cost, availability, seller rating, and offer link. Batch product IDs to review merchants in one run.

product_ids.title: Product IDs
product_ids.description: Billiger.de product IDs whose shop offers you want to compare.

page_size.title: Page size
page_size.description: Offers per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 50.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: relevance, price, total_price, shop_userreview_rating, shop_userreview_count, or shop_rating alias.

group_by_shop.title: Group By Shop
group_by_shop.description: Must remain false so offer pagination stays item-level and exhaustive.

all.title: All pages
all.description: Set true to exhaust every expected offer page.

offer_conditions.title: Offer Conditions
offer_conditions.description: Numeric condition IDs such as 1 or 1,2,3.
